versions.localizedDescription:
Automated nightly build for community testing (unsigned).

Every download is named ARMSX2-nightly-DATE-COMMIT-PLATFORM, so builds
from different nights stay distinguishable after you have downloaded them.

• macOS arm64: macOS-arm64.tar.xz
• Linux arm64: Linux-arm64-4K-pages.AppImage on most distros, or the 16K one on Asahi Linux and other Apple Silicon kernels (run getconf PAGESIZE if unsure)
• Windows arm64: Windows-arm64.zip
• RetroArch on Linux arm64: Linux-arm64-libretro-core.tar.zst, a 4K-page build
• Bare-display kmsdrm handhelds: Linux-arm64-SDL-handheld.tar.zst, a 4K-page build (Rocknix and Batocera run compositors, so use the Qt AppImage there instead)
• Android: Android-arm64.apk (installs as ARMSX2 Nightly, alongside the stable app)
• iOS: iOS-arm64.ipa, unsigned, sideload it (installs as ARMSX2 Nightly, alongside the stable app)

Coming from an old nightly? Nightlies are now a separate app, ARMSX2 Nightly, next to stable.

• Android: stable cannot install over an old nightly. Back up your saves and memory cards, uninstall the old nightly, then install the stable APK.
• iOS: your old nightly is the ARMSX2 iOS app and still has your saves. Copy them into ARMSX2 Nightly with the Files app.

What's new
• Texture packs: a This Game list in both browsers, shown while a game runs
• Driver list: show only the sources built for the device's GPU family
• arm64: a post-mortem in the log for a fault in recompiled code
• PageFaultHandler: a reporter for the faults it cannot handle
• Crash handler: let the fault's own signal kill the process
• Console: expose the log file's descriptor for crash handlers
• arm64: read guest words for the post-mortems without allocating
• AutoTune: lower the Android Display Resolution (HW scaler) to the render resolution when GPU-bound
• AutoTune: add Disabled to the download mode ladder, and step over a rung that did not help
• Driver list: a release with one zip per device lists each zip by its own name
• Translations: the batch's strings in all 19 languages
• Android: VR mode, named DNS host entries, touch stick travel, MdiEx drivers
• Auto Progressive Scan: hold Triangle+Cross through Criterion intros

Full changelog: https://github.com/ARMSX2/ARMSX2/compare/nightly-20261107...9144e4ff1fed43756809d8e68b3efc2505a51078

A manga and webtoon reader for your Suwayomi server.

✨ New Features

• Added Per-category settings for sort and filters to the Library, including changes made offline (@aaronbamblett)
• Added notifications when a new Tsumiru or server version is out, with Remind later and Ignore (@aaronbamblett)

⚙️ Changes

• Made long strip taps and keys scroll by Scroll distance instead of a whole page (@aaronbamblett)
• Changed Keep screen on to off by default (@aaronbamblett)
• Added Up and Down page turns in horizontal paged mode and N and P to change chapter (@aaronbamblett)

🚀 Improvements

• Hid empty category tabs while searching or filtering the library, with Show empty categories during search/filtering to keep them (@aaronbamblett)
• Moved Create registration code to Manage users and added an Edit button to user rows (@aaronbamblett)

🧩 Fixes

• Fixed the offline library not opening when Tsumiru starts without a connection (@aaronbamblett)
• Fixed Something went wrong showing on every page while reading offline (@aaronbamblett)
• Fixed library covers going blank in Safari after scrolling them off screen and back (@aaronbamblett)
• Fixed the paged reader restoring an old zoom when you return to a page (@aaronbamblett)
• Fixed saved searches from older WebUI versions not loading (@aaronbamblett)

Thanks to our Weblate translators: Damien O'Neil for French, Kisnov for Catalan, Andrei Stepanov for Russian and PainTownblue for Chinese.

Install

You'll need a running Suwayomi server. See Getting started.

Mobile

Android: download the universal APK below and open it to install. Smaller APKs for specific chip types are also attached.

iOS: the …-ios.ipa below is unsigned and has to be sideloaded. Add https://tsumiru.app/apps.json as a source in SideStore or AltStore to install it and get later releases as updates.

<details>
<summary>Which sideloading tool should I use?</summary>

• SideStore signs and refreshes the app on the device itself, with no computer needed after setup. Best for most people.
• AltStore expires every 7 days and only refreshes while a computer running AltServer is switched on and on the same Wi-Fi as your phone.
• TrollStore installs permanently with no expiry, but only works on older iPhones and iOS versions with the required vulnerability.

With SideStore or AltStore the app is re-signed periodically, which those tools automate. There is no App Store build.
</details>

Desktop

Windows: download …-windows-x64.zip, extract it anywhere, and run tsumiru.exe.

macOS: download …-macos-universal.zip, extract it, and move the app to Applications. If macOS blocks the first launch, approve it under System Settings → Privacy & Security.

Linux: the Flatpak is recommended and auto-updates.

flatpak remote-add --if-not-exists tsumiru https://flatpak.tsumiru.app/index.flatpakrepo
flatpak install tsumiru app.tsumiru.Tsumiru

Existing Flatpak installs keep receiving updates under io.github.aaronbamblett.tsumiru; no data, settings or logins move. AppImage/deb also keep that ID.

For a portable option, download …-linux-x86_64.AppImage, mark it executable with chmod +x, and run it.

Web

Download …-web.zip and serve its contents with any static web server.

apps.name: MiniWatts
apps.localizedDescription: An iPhone battery, charging and thermal instrument built on private iOS APIs — real charger watts, what actually reaches the cell, all 30 temperature sensors, and the USB-PD handshake.
apps.subtitle: An iPhone battery, charging and thermal instrument built on…

versions.localizedDescription:
Unsigned build — sign it with your own Apple ID before installing.
https://github.com/ResistanceTo/MiniWatts#install

改进

• 温度可以显示为华氏度。 设置 → 单位 里可选"自动 / °C / °F"。"自动"跟随系统地区，以及"设置 › 通用 › 语言与地区"里的"温度"选项，所以地区使用华氏度的用户升级后会直接看到 °F。App 各页、图表、热力图、悬浮读数、实时活动和小组件都按所选单位显示；原始数据仍显示传感器给出的 °C。(#25)
• 充电预估。 充电时，功率页会显示充到 80% 和充到 100% 还要多久，以及大约几点。时间根据电量实际上升的速度推算，不依赖电池能量设置；要等电量变化两次才会出现，通常需要几分钟。80% 以后按典型充电曲线估算，只是近似值。(#27)
• 显示版本号。 设置 → 关于 里显示当前版本，原始数据导出的第一行也带上了版本号。(#27)
• iPad 布局。 iPad 横屏和 13 英寸竖屏时，各页分成两栏；窄屏时仍是一栏。历史记录里单次充电的详情页在 iPad 上不再横向铺满。(#22)
• iPad 热力图。 在 iPad 上，发热页画的是 iPad 的轮廓，各区域按 iPad Pro 11 英寸的内部布局放置：主板在中间，两侧是电芯，充电芯片在 USB-C 接口旁。设备页和设置里的图标也换成了 iPad。(#13, #22)

修复

• 发热：CPU 簇（pACC、eACC）和图像处理器（ISP）等传感器以前被归入"其他传感器"，现在算作 SoC，SoC 区域的温度也会把它们算进去。iPhone 11 上 FrontCameraDie、BCMLBSkin 这类名字连写的传感器以前会被分错区（比如前摄像头被当成机身），现在会先拆词再归类。(#13, #14)
• 适配器页里"单次采样"那段说明以前在中文界面下一直显示英文，现在已有中文。

注意

• iPad 相关的改动只在模拟器里验证过，我手上没有 iPad。如果在 iPad 上看到问题，请从 设置 → 原始数据 复制导出并反馈。
• iPad 上"来自充电器"的功率偏低（#13）这次还没有修：要确认其余的输入由哪个传感器测量，需要一份充电时导出的原始数据。有 iPad 的话，请在充电时从 设置 → 原始数据 复制导出，贴到 #13。
• 充电预估无法知道是否开启了充电上限或优化电池充电。如果开着，电池会在上限前停下，"充到 100%"的时间就不准。

Improvements

• Temperatures can be shown in Fahrenheit. Settings → Units offers Automatic, °C or °F. Automatic follows your region and the Temperature option under Settings › General › Language & Region, so if your region uses Fahrenheit you will see °F straight after updating. Every page, the charts, the heat map, the floating meter, the Live Activity and the widget follow the setting; Raw data still shows the sensors' own °C. (#25)
• Charge forecast. While charging, the Power page shows how long until 80% and until 100%, and roughly when. It is worked out from how fast the battery level is actually rising, so it does not depend on the battery energy setting; it appears once the level has moved twice, usually within a few minutes. Past 80% it follows a typical charging curve and is approximate. (#27)
• Version number. Settings → About shows the installed version, and the first line of the Raw data dump includes it. (#27)
• iPad layout. On an iPad in landscape, and a 13-inch in portrait, every page uses two columns; narrower windows keep one. A session's detail page in History no longer stretches edge to edge on an iPad. (#22)
• iPad heat map. On an iPad the Thermal page draws an iPad, with the zones placed as in an iPad Pro 11-inch: logic board down the middle, a battery cell either side, the charge IC by the USB-C port. The Devices page and Settings use iPad icons too. (#13, #22)

Fixes

• Thermal: the CPU-cluster (pACC, eACC) and image-processor (ISP) sensors used to land under "Other sensors"; they now count as the SoC, and the SoC zone's temperature includes them. On an iPhone 11, run-together sensor names such as FrontCameraDie and BCMLBSkin were filed in the wrong zone (the front camera as chassis); names are now split into words before they are matched. (#13, #14)
• Adapter: the one-sample note always showed in English in the Chinese interface; it is now translated.

Notes

• The iPad changes were checked in the simulator only — I do not have an iPad. If something looks wrong on yours, copy the dump from Settings → Raw data and report it.
• The low "from charger" reading on an iPad (#13) is not fixed yet: finding which sensor carries the rest of the input needs a Raw data dump taken while charging. If you have an iPad, please copy one from Settings → Raw data while it charges and post it on #13.
• The charge forecast cannot tell whether a charge limit or Optimized Battery Charging is on. If one is, the battery stops short and the time to 100% will be wrong.

Full Changelog: https://github.com/ResistanceTo/MiniWatts/compare/v1.6.0...v1.7.0

versions.localizedDescription:
BCD is in alpha: an early stage of development, before beta. Many games run, many do not yet, and things can break between builds. When a game fails, please send a log.

This build brings everything since 0.1.630: OpenGL games, Steam Workshop and game versions, downloads from a PC on your network, an itch.io store, GOG and Epic improvements, an experimental EA store, the fixes for Rockstar's two Social Club updates of 3 and 4 November, Red Dead Redemption 2 with less memory, and new fixes from the logs you sent with Send Log.

Rockstar Social Club updates (3 and 4 November): after Rockstar updated Social Club (2.4.0.296, then 2.4.0.302), the Rockstar Games Launcher stayed a gray window and Red Dead Redemption 2, GTA V and GTA IV could not start. BCD supports both versions now. If your game still shows a gray launcher, use Reset to Recommended on its page (see below).

New

• OpenGL games: a game that draws with OpenGL can now run. On the game's page, Direct3D › OpenGL chooses Desktop OpenGL (through Vulkan on Metal) or OpenGL ES; it is off unless chosen, and Settings › Graphics says where to find it. Recommended settings turn it on for The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth, Mewgenics, DOOM 3: BFG Edition, Darkest Dungeon, Battle Brothers, Jetboard Joust and Stardew Valley (Desktop OpenGL) and Balatro (OpenGL ES), and Auto-tune turns it on after the failures that need it (no OpenGL context, GameMaker's OpenGL runner, LÖVE games). artwork handling for XB.Live Core, DukeX Core, and special test titles.

This release has almost everything planned for 1.0.0: a new design, a rebuilt player and hundreds of fixes. But so much has changed that it needs testing on more devices and libraries than we can cover ourselves.

• Work that keeps going on Android: downloads, library updates, restores and syncs continue in the background, under one notification (#1092).

Video player

• New controls on phone, desktop and TV, with episodes reachable from the top bar and lock and skip under the timeline on mobile.
• Video filters: brightness, contrast, saturation, gamma and hue, kept for the next episodes. Gamma is hidden where the video output cannot apply it.
• Audio delay: from -5 to +5 seconds.
• Remember volume and brightness between episodes, and keep the fit from one episode to the next.
• New "Turn subtitles on" switch, so episodes can start without subtitles.
• "Use my subtitle style" now really gives the default style back when turned off.
• VAAPI and VDPAU hardware decoding on Linux.
• Rebind the player's keyboard shortcuts.
• Fixed: a freeze in the player's event handling, crashes when chapter marks change, previous and next buttons on mobile, and controls under the camera cutout in landscape.

Library and browsing

• Swipe sideways to switch between Manga, Anime and Novels, in the library and in Browse.
• Select everything between two entries, in the library and in chapter lists.
• Skip completed series, series with unread chapters or series not started in library updates. The categories' "Skip updates" option now takes effect too.

Downloads

RewindBox 0.0.10 — Build 559

Everything since 0.0.9-fix.1 (Build 530).

Interface
• Refined Liquid Glass interface: one-line main header, a new "NeoStation" style (solid accent pill, matte surfaces, no blur), a working Interface preview with Apply/Revert, and floating side-menu bubbles in Settings and Scraper.
• New options in 12 languages: status bar items, accent colour, controller focus style, LB/RB glyphs and side-menu panel.
• ROM folder changes saved in quick succession no longer fail.

Nintendo Switch (embedded MeloNX)
• Backend threading is now on by default, as in the standalone MeloNX app, with a per-game switch.
• Game FPS is shown in the RAM overlay.
• In-game MoltenVK choice: the standalone MeloNX app's own MoltenVK is the default; RewindBox's version remains available and is used automatically if the other fails to load.
• New "Emulation priority" option in the in-game menu (default unchanged). The screen no longer auto-locks during a game.
• Closing a game after a GPU teardown error no longer leaves the app stuck on "closing": the session is stopped safely and explained.
• Imports report completion without a full library rescan, updates are matched to the installed base game, audio playback starts correctly on the Apple backend, and pipeline compilation errors are handled without breaking later draws.
• A per-second performance line in the app log helps troubleshooting.

PlayStation 3 (RPCS3)
• PS3 disc images (.iso) in your library folder now launch through RPCS3: RewindBox reads the disc, offers to install it into RPCS3 (with its .dkey/.key file) and boots it. Renamed or removed images stay in sync, and the original can optionally be deleted after installation.
• The God of War III profile is now actually applied; an old custom configuration previously disabled it silently.
• Engine improvements:
• SPU code already in the cache loads without rebuilding the LLVM pass pipeline.
• GPU copies that fully overwrite their destination no longer read the old contents back.
• Fewer redundant texture hashes, plus a new experimental "Texture validation per FIFO batch" setting (automatic for God of War III only).
• Faster lookup of identical vertex shaders, fewer copies during synchronous shader compilation, fewer redundant pipeline builds, and shader-cache writes moved off the RSX thread.
• Less CPU spent waiting for the GPU, and faster JIT cache writes.
• Public ARMSX3 fixes: SPU warm-up order, PKG path containment, debug SELF decryption, in-memory savestate files, cellSaveData SDK 2.6 limit.
• ISO mounts are preserved when restoring a savestate.
• New experimental "MoltenVK Asynchronous Submits" setting (off by default).
• Additional bounded diagnostics (timeline, GPU waits, read-back origins, optimization counters) to measure performance.
